name: AgentOps Knowledge Activation Operator Surfaces Canary
description: Offline public canary for ao knowledge native activation, harvest-catalog fallback materialization, knowledge startup consumers, and shared/Codex knowledge-activation skill contracts.

cases.title: ao knowledge native activation tests pass
cases.objective: Protect full activation with workspace packet builders, native belief/playbook/brief/gap builders, and the harvest-catalog fallback path when workspace packet builders are absent.

cases.title: startup consumers read generated knowledge surfaces
cases.objective: Protect Codex startup and factory flows that consume matched briefings, belief books, and playbooks after knowledge activation produces operator surfaces.

cases.title: shared and Codex knowledge-activation skill contracts validate
cases.objective: Keep shared and Codex runtime skill copies linked to the ao knowledge command family, canonical output surfaces, and script-contract references.

cases.title: operator docs describe native harvest fallback and avoid stale builder requirements
cases.objective: Prevent docs from telling agents that activation always requires workspace-local builders or deprecated activation builder scripts.

inputs.shell: rg -F -q 'promoted `.agents/harvest/latest.json` catalog' skills/knowledge-activation/SKILL.md skills-codex/knowledge-activation/SKILL.md && rg -F -q 'harvest-catalog substrate materialization' skills/knowledge-activation/references/script-contracts.md skills-codex/knowledge-activation/references/script-contracts.md && ! rg -n 'book_of_beliefs_build.py|playbook_build.py|briefing_build.py|when workspace builders are available' skills/knowledge-activation skills-codex/knowledge-activation cli/cmd/ao/codex.go

cases.title: ao knowledge source contains explicit native substrate fallback
cases.objective: Keep the implementation auditable: missing packet builders must route through an explicit native substrate preparation step before native operator builders run.

cases.title: harvest fallback regression fixture is committed in tests
cases.objective: Ensure the unit test fixture exercises promoted harvest artifacts rather than only prebuilt topic packets.

expectations.value: Harvested activation evidence should become operator surfaces without local packet builders.
